latin_text: Augustine also asserted, as Gregory later confirmed, that there is no visible thing among us over which an angelic power does not preside, and that all bodies are constantly ruled by a rational spirit of life. Origen likewise, in his commentary on the book of Numbers, says that the world needs angels to preside over animals and their birth and also over the increase of bushes and plantings and other things.
english_translation: Augustine also asserted, as Gregory later confirmed, that there is no visible thing among us over which an angelic power does not preside, and that all bodies are constantly ruled by a rational spirit of life. Origen likewise, in his commentary on the book of Numbers, says that the world needs angels to preside over animals and their birth and also over the increase of bushes and plantings and other things.
exegesis: Every created thing (animal, plant, mineral) is governed by an appropriate angelic order. This is universal cosmic governance through angelic mediation.
notes: HARVESTER passage: H.TE3.C4.2 | Angelic governance of all created things; cosmic order through angelic hierarchy
